summary_en: Stock exchange contract executed to acquire 100% of Pavilions Co., Ltd. (entertainment business, music/video content and intellectual property). Consideration: 2,000,000 ordinary shares of THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY. Pavilions' representative Tetssuya Komuro becomes shareholder post-exchange; to remain as representative director. Simplified exchange procedure (会社法370条) applied. Effective date not disclosed in excerpt.
summary_jp: パビリオンズ株式会社の完全子会社化を目的とした簡易株式交換契約を締結。対価は当社普通株式200万株。小室哲哉氏が株主となり、代表取締役として継続。エンタテインメント事業強化を狙う。
